sections.html:
• Type: stem plant
  • Origin: Asia
  • Height: 20–30+ cm
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2 demand: medium
Plant it in groups, and make sure the water temperature does not exceed 28 °C (this makes the leaves much smaller and the plant more leggy).

Cardamine lyrata is actually a marsh plant from Japan. But it is also a familiar aquarium plant which thrives under water with 20–50 cm long stems. A characteristic trailing growth form makes it highly decorative, and 'aerial' roots often form on the plant itself. Also suitable in garden ponds in the summer.
